video.title: AI欧腐《狼王的命定之人/The Alpha King’s Fated Omega》
video.desc:
The second son of the Vance family, Ryan, was bullied for being unable to shift into a wolf. At the Blood Moon Gathering, his brother Damian stole his fiancée and humiliated him, but the Alpha King Jax rescued him, awakening their fated bond. After trials, betrayals, and near-death, Ryan confessed his love, awakening the holy white wolf to save Jax. They finally united.

Ryan 是 Vance 家族的次子，因为无法化身为狼而受尽欺凌。在血月聚会上，他的兄弟 Damian 抢走了他的未婚妻，还当众羞辱他。Alpha 王 Jax 出手相救，两人之间的命定羁绊就此觉醒。历经重重考验、背叛与生死一线之后，Ryan 终于坦白了自己的爱意，并唤醒了神圣白狼的力量，救下了 Jax。两人最终走到了一起。
